name: Sableis Hespwyn
keeps: the oath he is named for breaking
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: The word alchemy carries an Arabic article on the front of it because of this tradition.
text: Sableis hespwyn of the counted step, carries between for the 18th tranche, doors 162 to 171. Keeps the oath he is named for breaking. Reads Jabir ibn Hayyan (Geber).
